primary_products.value: Wildfire incident management and situational awareness software

quotes.quote: IGNIS is Bridger Aerospace’s wildfire technology platform that provides a common operating picture for wildland firefighters. It enables teams to share intelligence, stay up to date on evolving incidents, and access aircraft livestreams and the latest aviation map products. IGNIS supports offline data sharing, air-to-ground integration, wildfire-specific map layers, and fire weather updates, helping firefighters, incident management teams, and agencies coordinate more effectively during active wildfire operations.
Joining an incident is free for anyone with an invite. Creating and managing an incident requires IGNIS Pro.
